ana_cs: Hey team — proactive heads-up on Starlit onboarding. Observed during yesterday's soak: 95th pctl latency spikes ~820ms on chat flows during peak (12–2pm PST) and token spend is ~1.9x baseline. Customer is on hosted LLM by default.

My proposal:
1) Pilot an 8-bit quantized variant (model: `llama-3-8q`) for most generation traffic to cut unit cost.
2) Route peak business-hours traffic to a Dedicated-West pool and keep hosted as fallback off-peak.
3) Canary at 10% for 24h with automated perf + quality guards (rollback if regs breach).
Also enable prefix KV caching (TTL 30m) for repeated prompts. I can run the canary Tue 9am PST. Thoughts? :wave:

miguel_se: Do you have projected token savings and an estimate of quality delta for the 8q? want to quantify renewal risk before moving heavy traffic.

rachel_sre: Lab numbers: ~38% token-cost reduction, p95 latency delta -28ms on average with quantized path. Quality evals on our prompt-set show <1.5% deviation on the primary intent metrics. KV cache reduced repeated context tokens by ~22% in emulation. Example log snippet: `req=starlit-2027-09 perf: p95 820ms -> 792ms (quant)`

sam_ops: We should gate with automated rollback. Suggest monitor rules: error_rate > 3% OR p95 > baseline+200ms OR quality_drift > 2% -> rollback to hosted. Can we wire that into the canary?

rachel_sre: yes — we can create an automated SLO watcher that adjusts canary to 0% and alerts on-call. I'll draft the playbook (traces, roll-forward, roll-back commands).

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: org=starlit, start=2027-09-12T16:00:00Z, canary=10%, monitors=[p95_latency,error_rate,quality_regression], notify_channel=#customer-success.

ana_cs: (typo) meant: perfect — i'll coordinate the enablement call with Starlit PM and attach a trimmed prompt set for the quality guard. @miguel_se @rachel_sre please confirm availability Tue 9am PST. :thumbsup:

miguel_se: i'm in.

rachel_sre: in too, will bring traces and the rollback playbook.

ana_cs: i'll send calendar + pre-read. after the canary, if numbers match lab, proposed next step is 50% routing for business hours and a 30-day observation window to feed renewal playbook.
